caption: The drawing depicts two objects that appear to be powder horns, both made from animal horn and depicted in a realistic style using various shades of brown and beige. The larger powder horn is positioned diagonally from the upper right to the lower left, with a wood-textured stoppers at both the wide and narrow ends, and is fitted with a decorative yellowish cord that loops around and is finished with three tassels. The horn shows a smooth gradient of brown colors with lighter beige highlights and shadowing. Beneath the larger horn lies a second, smaller horn, displayed horizontally and also colored in shades of brown with beige highlights; this smaller horn has a similar cord with a single tassel attached. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. There is a small red marking with the letters "M.A.R.S." located to the left of the larger horn's middle section.
title: Powder Horn
